name.description: The application name. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the dasherized Application node id.

theme.description: Angular Material prebuilt theme name. Defaults to indigo-pink. Not allowed with --document.

typography.description: Include Material typography styles. Defaults to true. Not allowed with --document.

animations.description: Enable Angular animations. Defaults to true. Not allowed with --document.

routing.description: Enable routing. Defaults to true. Not allowed with --document.

ssr.description: Configure the generated application for Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG/Prerendering). Defaults to false.

zoneless.description: Generate an application that does not use zone.js. Defaults to true.

defaults.description: Disable interactive input prompts for options with a default.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles an Application node: name, toolbar [title], routing (Routing child), Presentation [theme]/[typography]/[animations], and sidenav links for every DashboardPage.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID of the Application node. When omitted, targets the first Application element. Requires --document.
